_note: Hebrew pronunciation lexicon for templates/core/pron.py. 'words': plain spelling (no nikud) -> the exact vowelised spelling sent to TTS, used instead of Dicta's automatic nikud. Add a word here whenever the Hebrew ASR check (out/<id>.report.json transcript.misread) or Noam flags a misreading. 'masc_nouns': a number right before these nouns is read in the masculine form (שלושה ימים); otherwise feminine (שלוש שנים).
